mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, goal_id, type, title, period_start, period_end, content_json, model, record_count, total_minutes, completed_tasks, average_focus, created_at FROM ai_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, user_id, goal_id, type, title, period_start, period_end, content_json, model, record_count, total_minutes, completed_tasks, average_focus, created_at FROM ai_report WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_report (user_id, goal_id, type, title, period_start, period_end, content_json, model, record_count, total_minutes, completed_tasks, average_focus) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{contentJson}, #{model}, #{recordCount}, #{totalMinutes}, #{completedTasks}, #{averageFocus})
